svg.title: Retry a caller's operation
svg.desc: Milestone 1 overview in six perspective columns: Domain, Architecture, Subsystem Design, Subsystem Interfaces, State Management and Verification. Green outlines mark new subjects, blue outlines mark changed subjects and gray outlines mark unchanged context. The report viewer passes load_report and a RetryPolicy to retry(). The attempt loop calls the operation again only after a listed exception and stops at max_attempts, re-raising the last exception. Checks expect the report after three reads with a limit of three, the read-2 ReportNotReady with a limit of two, and an immediate PermissionError.
svg.text: Proposed library • retry() repeats the caller's operation after a listed exception, up to max_attempts, then re-raises the last one.
run end to end by the smoke test: prints “Report ready: 3 rows.”
